excerpts.raw:
Transactions of the Horticultural Society of London, Volumen 3
1820

LARGE LOVE APPLE

Tomate Grosse in French

SMALL LOVE APPLE

Tomate petite

Globular fruit, rather flattened at the stalk and apex, about four inches in circumference; it sometimes varies from its even shape, shewing a tendency to form the distorted irregular lobes, separated from each other by sutures, of the common large kind.

PEAR-SHAPED LOVE APPLE

Tomate en Poire

bears egg-shaped fruit, with its narrow end next the stalk, about two inches longs, and between three and four inches in circumference in its widest part, all its fruits are not exactly of the same shape: this kind seems more tender than the others, as its produce does not ripen so early; it is figured by Bunal, in his account of the gnneus Solanum.

CHERRY LOVE APPLE

Tomate Cerise

has fruit the size of a large cherry, and quite round.

LARGE YELLOW LOVE APPLE

it is not much cultivated, and its seed was amongst the collection received from France in the last spring.

correpsonding in all points, except that of colour, with the figure of the large red love apple.

SMALL OR CHERRY YELLOW LOVE APPLE

Tomate petite jaune

its fruit measures from three to four inches in circumference, is a pale yellow colour, from ten to twelve growing on each raceme; it is globular, but a little flattened at top and bottom; some shwe a disposition to swell into distict lobes, and become of a larger size; from the seed of such fruit, if necessary, the large sort might be raised.

is figured and described as a distinct species by Jacquin, under the name of Solanum pseudo-lycoercium

Hortus Eystettensis gerarde and parkinson besler
